tools.name: document_list
tools.description: List documents at a reference / in a book. A verse's purport = document_list(source, tokens, kind:"commentary").

params.name: tokens
params.description: A specific reference; omit for the whole book.

tools.name: excerpt_prepare
tools.description: Generate (or fetch, if cached) the audio clip for a lecture passage and return its playable URL. This is the excerpt player's Play action — it is called for you by the player UI on demand. Agents should use lecture_excerpt to show the player, not call this directly. Idempotent: same track+window returns the same cached clip.

tools.name: lecture_excerpt
tools.description: Let the user HEAR a lecture passage inline. Call this when the user wants to LISTEN to a specific moment in a track — e.g. from a search(types:["track"]) hit, pass its track_id plus start_ms/end_ms. Renders an inline audio player that generates the clip on demand (public share-audio, max 10 minutes).

params.name: track_id
params.description: track_id (from a search track hit or track_list).

tools.name: media_get
tools.description: Show/play an existing corpus VIDEO clip inline. Call this when the user wants to WATCH a clip found via search(types:["media"]) — pass the hit's media_id. Renders an inline video player.

params.name: id
params.description: Media clip item_id (from a search media hit's media_id).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic + lexical search over the corpus. Returns verses, documents, track passages and titles matching a natural-language query, each with the id needed to fetch the full record (verse_id→verse_get, document_id→document_get, track_id+start_ms/end_ms→transcript_window; media_id→media_get to play the clip). Every filter is optional. Use min_score to drop weak matches.

params.name: types
params.description: Subset of verse|document|track|title|media (default all). A `media` hit is a short video clip playable via media_get.

params.name: tokens
params.description: With source, restrict to a reference. A bare chapter number covers the WHOLE chapter ("7" = all of BG ch 7; "5.5" = SB canto 5 ch 5); add the verse for one verse ("7.1"). For tracks it means tracks ci

params.name: min_score
params.description: Drop hits scoring below this cosine floor (0..1, default 0 = no floor).

tools.name: source_get
tools.description: Get one book by id or code ("source_…" or "BG"/"БГ").

tools.name: source_list
tools.description: List all books (Caitanya-caritāmṛta is three sources).

tools.name: source_resolve
tools.description: Find a book by name (fuzzy): "gita", "бхагаватам", "CC Madhya".

tools.name: track_get
tools.description: Get a track (lecture/conversation): metadata, cited references, transcript/pdf availability.

tools.name: track_list
tools.description: List tracks, filterable by reference (source[+tokens] = tracks citing it), author/location/kind/date/lang. No filter ⇒ recent tracks (date desc).

params.name: lang
params.description: Has a transcript in this language.

params.name: source
params.description: Book code / source_id — tracks citing this book.

params.name: tokens
params.description: With source, filter to tracks citing this reference. A bare chapter number covers the WHOLE chapter ("7" = any BG 7.x lecture); add the verse for one verse ("7.1").

tools.name: transcript_window
tools.description: Read a track's transcript around a time window (from a search track hit or track_list). Widen with pad_ms.

tools.name: verse_get
tools.description: Get a verse: original (Devanagari/Bengali) + stored IAST transliteration + translation. Address by ref ("BG 2.13"), source+tokens, or verse id.

params.name: lang
params.description: If set: single translation; else a translations map.

tools.name: verse_list
tools.description: List the verses of a book / chapter. Skips .0 chapter summaries; collapses merged verses into one item with a covers span.

resources.name: Corpus excerpt player
resources.description: Inline audio player that generates a lecture-passage clip on demand.

resources.name: Corpus video player
resources.description: Inline video player for a corpus media clip.
